name: AI UI Style Vault Agent Index
purpose: Machine-readable entry point for agents choosing and adapting UI references from this vault.
selectionProtocol: Inspect the target repository and identify product type, audience, page needs, interaction density, tone, accessibility constraints, and styling stack.
Read guides/AGENT_BUILD_CHECKLIST.md before building, including visual QA, asset QA, and handoff gates.
Read guides/SITE_INTERACTION_PATTERNS.md when the target site needs rotating hero media, dropdowns, mega menus, category browsing, brand grids, or top-nav interaction.
Create a VAULT_SELECTION.md record from templates/VAULT_SELECTION.md before implementation.
Read catalog.json and shortlist 3 to 5 style bundles using category, bestFor, tags, theme, northStar, primaryColors, fonts, and available files.
Read screen-catalog.json and shortlist page-specific screen references for required page types.
Score style candidates using product fit, page coverage, density fit, tone fit, implementation fit, accessibility fit, and license risk.
Choose one primary style bundle, optional supporting style bundles only for clear gaps, and one screen reference per important page type.
Read the selected folders deeply before implementation.
Implement an original UI in the target repository using the selected tokens, rules, and page patterns.
Run generated-site, visual, asset, responsive, and available project checks before handoff.

outputContractBeforeImplementation.primaryStyle: Name and path of selected primary style bundle.
outputContractBeforeImplementation.supportingReferences: Screen or style paths used for page-specific behavior.
outputContractBeforeImplementation.fitRationale: Short explanation tied to product type, audience, density, tone, and stack.
outputContractBeforeImplementation.adaptationPlan: Tokens, components, layout patterns, and states to implement.
outputContractBeforeImplementation.copyAssetPolicy: State that protected logos, screenshots, exact product copy, and proprietary layouts will not be copied.
outputContractBeforeImplementation.selectionRecord: Create or update VAULT_SELECTION.md in the generated project or target repo before implementation.

requiredBuildArtifacts: VAULT_SELECTION.md or equivalent filled selection record
Visual QA evidence or notes for desktop and mobile
Available lint, typecheck, test, and build results
Localhost URL when the user asks to see the build locally
requiredGeneratedSiteChecks: No hotlinked target-site images or copied protected media
No placeholder, lorem ipsum, TODO-heavy UI, or console debugging
Headers and sticky elements do not cover headings, forms, cards, or anchor targets
Forms, fieldsets, labels, legends, focus states, and text wrapping are visually checked
Desktop and mobile layouts have no obvious overlap
safetyRules: Use references as inspiration for original implementation unless a source explicitly grants reuse rights.
Do not vendor screenshots, videos, logos, or brand assets without permission.
Do not clone a protected brand or page pixel-for-pixel.
Preserve token logic, spacing rhythm, mood, component behavior, and page-type structure when useful.
Tailor information architecture, copy, navigation, feature hierarchy, responsiveness, and accessibility to the target product.
